ac1.command: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && node -e "const fs=require(\"fs\");const p=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(\"./frontend/package.json\",\"utf8\"));const d=Object.assign({},p.dependencies,p.devDependencies);const r=[\"react\",\"react-dom\",\"react-router-dom\",\"@tanstack/react-query\",\"axios\",\"tailwindcss\",\"vitest\",\"@testing-library/react\",\"msw\",\"eslint\",\"prettier\",\"typescript\"];const b=r.filter(k=>!d[k]||!/^[0-9]/.test(d[k]));if(b.length){console.error(\"unpinned or missing: \"+b.join(\", \"));process.exit(1)}" && git ls-files --error-unmatch frontend/package-lock.json >/dev/null'
ac1.note: Node/manifest half ran verbatim under WSL (exit 0, all 12 packages pinned exact). Git half (git ls-files --error-unmatch frontend/package-lock.json) executed via Windows git toolchain (exit 0) because WSL git cannot resolve this worktree's Windows-path gitdir pointer; same adaptation the Builder used and the one prescribed by the run environment.

ac2.command: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npm install --no-audit --no-fund" >/dev/null'
ac2.note: npm install completed (474 packages, exit 0) with the documented env workaround `set npm_config_allow_scripts= &&` injected into the cmd.exe invocation: the Windows shell exports npm_config_allow_scripts=msgpackr-extract which makes npm 11.17.0 abort project-scoped installs with EALLOWSCRIPTS regardless of repo contents (verbatim command reproduces EALLOWSCRIPTS even with the Builder's frontend/.npmrc present; the empty-set override is the only fix). Environment artifact, not a builder deviation; ac4/ac5 verbatim passed without the workaround.

ac3.command: bash -c 'test -f frontend/src/main.tsx && grep -q createRoot frontend/src/main.tsx && grep -q "id=\"root\"" frontend/index.html && ls frontend/tailwind.config.* >/dev/null && grep -RqE "@tailwind (base|components|utilities)" frontend/src --include=*.css && grep -RqE "className=\"[^\"]*(flex|grid|min-h-screen|mx-auto|p-[0-9]|text-[a-z])" frontend/src --include=*.tsx'

ac4.command: bash -c 'test -f frontend/package.json && find frontend/src -name "*.test.tsx" | grep -q . && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npm test -- --run" >/dev/null'
ac4.note: Vitest 1.6.0 non-watch run: 1 test file, 3/3 tests passed (app_shell.test.tsx). Passed both with workaround and verbatim.

ac5.command: bash -c 'test -f frontend/tsconfig.json && D=$(wslpath -w "$PWD/frontend") && cmd.exe /c "cd /d $D && npx tsc --noEmit"'
ac5.note: Strict tsconfig (strict, noUnusedLocals, noUncheckedIndexedAccess) compiles cleanly; passed verbatim.
